findings.text: the s9 verdict rests on a reproduction of the wrong layer: repro_s9.log records 'classify_pointer path not measurable: AttributeError' and 'full parses across 10 unchanged classify_pointer calls: 2', so the watcher's own entry point did not complete and produced 2 parses over 10 calls rather than the 10 the section's premise implies; the reported figure of 10 is from observe_log, and the watcher reaches it through _stream_budget at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2596, which short-circuits when the pointer already carries a folded budget, so a repair starting from this repro may cache a layer the failing path does not exercise and leave 'a watcher re-reads every stream on every poll' unaddressed for the observed-pointer case.

justifications.fit: report.md follows the deliverable contract it was given — no figure (the done_when names no artifact), no plan edit, and the required dispatch order with shared files (report.md:180) — and it surfaces two plan-level defects a currency node exists to find (the s6 text names skills/reckon-ship/... which does not exist; s9's write list omits reckon/mcp_views.py).
